content.title: After the warning ends
content.summary: Know what to do before anyone leaves the shelter room.

skill.cue: The tornado warning has ended and you don't know yet whether there is damage nearby.
skill.action: Check official updates before you leave the room, and stay clear of fallen power lines.
skill.why: Ready.gov says to pay attention to EAS, NOAA Weather Radio, and local authorities for updated information.
checkInPrompts: The tornado warning ends. What do you do before going outside?
After a tornado, where do you get updated information?
